title: A Fascinating Walk Through Barcelona’s History with a Chinese-Speaking Guide
text: I had a wonderful experience on the Gothic Quarter walking tour in Barcelona! The tour was conducted in Chinese, which made it easy to understand the history and stories behind the old town. Hongying was very knowledgeable and explained everything in an engaging and interesting way. I learned so much about Barcelona’s history, culture, and hidden corners that I would probably have missed exploring on my own. Highly recommend this tour to anyone who wants to discover the real stories behind Barcelona’s historic streets!
author: sofiy762

title: Loved exploring the Gothic Quarter!
text: We had such a great time on this Gothic Quarter walking tour! Our guide was super friendly and knew so much about the history and hidden gems of Barcelona. We got to see some amazing spots we would have totally missed on our own. Highly recommend if you want a mix of history, stories, and local vibes. Really made the quarter come alive!
author: sof_ay404

text: It was a short 2-hour tour, but I was so impressed that I was able to experience over 2,000 years of history in the Gothic Quarter with my guide.  He was friendly, enthusiastic, and eager to show me more places to visit! He also recommended some great shops to buy souvenirs and took lots of photos with me with his tips and tricks.
author: sof_ay404
